title: The Deadline of the Free Port
author: Rosalind Ishikawa
blurb: Dominic Crane, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then the safe house is listed for sale — with photos of the inside — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
